activities_body_check.name: activities_body_check
activities_body_check.value: ("activities"."type" <> 'note') = ("activities"."body" is null) and ("activities"."body" is null or char_length("activities"."body") between 1 and 2000)

agent_actions_decided_check.name: agent_actions_decided_check
agent_actions_decided_check.value: ("agent_actions"."decided_at" is null and "agent_actions"."decided_by" is null) = ("agent_actions"."state" <> 'approved' and "agent_actions"."state" <> 'rejected' and "agent_actions"."state" <> 'dismissed')

agent_configs_every_agent_check.name: agent_configs_every_agent_check
agent_configs_every_agent_check.value: "agent_configs"."agent" is not null or ("agent_configs"."action_type" is null and "agent_configs"."autonomy" is null and "agent_configs"."daily_spend_cap_paise" is null)

audit_logs_actor_check.name: audit_logs_actor_check
audit_logs_actor_check.value: "audit_logs"."command" like 'auth.%' or ("audit_logs"."actor_principal_id" is not null and "audit_logs"."actor_kind" is not null)

commission_accruals_cancel_check.name: commission_accruals_cancel_check
commission_accruals_cancel_check.value:
("commission_accruals"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("commission_accruals"."cancelled_at" is not null)
       and ("commission_accruals"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("commission_accruals"."cancelled_by" is null)

composite_supply_rules_range_check.name: composite_supply_rules_range_check
composite_supply_rules_range_check.value: "composite_supply_rules"."goods_share_pct" between 0 and 100 and "composite_supply_rules"."services_share_pct" between 0 and 100 and "composite_supply_rules"."goods_rate_pct" between 0 and 100 and "composite_supply_rules"."services_rate_pct" between 0 and 100

customer_sites_match_village_idx.name: customer_sites_match_village_idx
customer_sites_match_village_idx.where: "customer_sites"."village" is not null and "customer_sites"."archived_at" is null

customer_sites_pin_idx.name: customer_sites_pin_idx
customer_sites_pin_idx.where: "customer_sites"."pin" is not null and "customer_sites"."archived_at" is null

customer_sites_point_check.name: customer_sites_point_check
customer_sites_point_check.value: ("customer_sites"."lat" is null or "customer_sites"."lat" between -90 and 90) and ("customer_sites"."lng" is null or "customer_sites"."lng" between -180 and 180)

dealer_outstanding_unpaid_check.name: dealer_outstanding_unpaid_check
dealer_outstanding_unpaid_check.value:
("dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_date" is null) = ("dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_no" is null)
       and ("dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_date" is null or "dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_date" <= "dealer_outstanding"."as_of")
       and ("dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_no" is null or length(btrim("dealer_outstanding"."oldest_unpaid_invoice_no")) between 1 and 60)

duplicate_candidates_pair_check.name: duplicate_candidates_pair_check
duplicate_candidates_pair_check.value:
("duplicate_candidates"."kind" = 'customer' and "duplicate_candidates"."account_id" < "duplicate_candidates"."other_account_id"
            and "duplicate_candidates"."opportunity_id" is null and "duplicate_candidates"."other_opportunity_id" is null)
        or ("duplicate_candidates"."kind" = 'lead' and "duplicate_candidates"."opportunity_id" < "duplicate_candidates"."other_opportunity_id"
            and "duplicate_candidates"."account_id" is null and "duplicate_candidates"."other_account_id" is null)

duplicate_candidates_decided_check.name: duplicate_candidates_decided_check
duplicate_candidates_decided_check.value: ("duplicate_candidates"."state" = 'open') = ("duplicate_candidates"."decided_by" is null) and ("duplicate_candidates"."decided_by" is null) = ("duplicate_candidates"."decided_at" is null)

import_jobs_entity_ids_check.name: import_jobs_entity_ids_check
import_jobs_entity_ids_check.value: "import_jobs"."entity_ids" is null or cardinality("import_jobs"."entity_ids") between 1 and 20

inbox_items_routed_check.name: inbox_items_routed_check
inbox_items_routed_check.value: "inbox_items"."kind" <> 'agent_suggestion' or ("inbox_items"."segment" is null and "inbox_items"."note" is null)

notification_preferences_quiet_check.name: notification_preferences_quiet_check
notification_preferences_quiet_check.value:
("notification_preferences"."quiet_from" is null) = ("notification_preferences"."quiet_to" is null)
        and ("notification_preferences"."quiet_from" is null or "notification_preferences"."quiet_from" <> "notification_preferences"."quiet_to")
        and ("notification_preferences"."type" is null or "notification_preferences"."quiet_from" is null)

pin_codes_taluk_check.name: pin_codes_taluk_check
pin_codes_taluk_check.value: "pin_codes"."taluk" is null or char_length("pin_codes"."taluk") between 1 and 120

push_subscriptions_keys_check.name: push_subscriptions_keys_check
push_subscriptions_keys_check.value: char_length("push_subscriptions"."p256dh") between 80 and 100 and char_length("push_subscriptions"."auth") between 16 and 32

quote_lines_tax_check.name: quote_lines_tax_check
quote_lines_tax_check.value:
("quote_lines"."tax_rate_id" is not null and "quote_lines"."tax_rate_pct" is not null and "quote_lines"."composite_rule_id" is null and "quote_lines"."goods_rate_pct" is null and "quote_lines"."services_rate_pct" is null and "quote_lines"."goods_taxable" is null and "quote_lines"."services_taxable" is null)
       or ("quote_lines"."tax_rate_id" is null and "quote_lines"."tax_rate_pct" is null and "quote_lines"."composite_rule_id" is not null and "quote_lines"."works_contract" and "quote_lines"."goods_rate_pct" is not null and "quote_lines"."services_rate_pct" is not null and "quote_lines"."goods_taxable" is not null and "quote_lines"."services_taxable" is not null)

quotes_acceptance_check.name: quotes_acceptance_check
quotes_acceptance_check.value:
("quotes"."state" = 'accepted') = ("quotes"."accepted_via" is not null)
       and ("quotes"."signed_file_id" is not null) = ("quotes"."accepted_via" is not distinct from 'signed_upload')

sales_order_lines_tax_check.name: sales_order_lines_tax_check
sales_order_lines_tax_check.value:
("sales_order_lines"."tax_rate_id" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."tax_rate_pct" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."composite_rule_id" is null and "sales_order_lines"."goods_rate_pct" is null and "sales_order_lines"."services_rate_pct" is null and "sales_order_lines"."goods_taxable" is null and "sales_order_lines"."services_taxable" is null)
       or ("sales_order_lines"."tax_rate_id" is null and "sales_order_lines"."tax_rate_pct" is null and "sales_order_lines"."composite_rule_id" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."works_contract" and "sales_order_lines"."goods_rate_pct" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."services_rate_pct" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."goods_taxable" is not null and "sales_order_lines"."services_taxable" is not null)

sales_orders_confirmed_check.name: sales_orders_confirmed_check
sales_orders_confirmed_check.value:
("sales_orders"."state" <> 'draft' or ("sales_orders"."confirmed_at" is null and "sales_orders"."confirmed_by" is null))
       and ("sales_orders"."state" not in ('confirmed', 'partially_dispatched', 'dispatched', 'invoiced', 'closed')
            or ("sales_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null and "sales_orders"."confirmed_by" is not null))

sales_orders_credit_hold_check.name: sales_orders_credit_hold_check
sales_orders_credit_hold_check.value:
("sales_orders"."credit_held_at" is null) = ("sales_orders"."credit_hold_reason" is null)
       and ("sales_orders"."credit_held_at" is null) = ("sales_orders"."credit_hold_json" is null)
       and ("sales_orders"."credit_hold_reason" is null or "sales_orders"."credit_hold_reason" in ('credit_limit_exceeded', 'credit_overdue', 'credit_limit_missing'))

sales_orders_credit_release_check.name: sales_orders_credit_release_check
sales_orders_credit_release_check.value:
("sales_orders"."credit_release_by" is null) = ("sales_orders"."credit_release_reason" is null)
       and ("sales_orders"."credit_release_by" is null) = ("sales_orders"."credit_released_at" is null)
       and ("sales_orders"."credit_release_reason" is null or length(btrim("sales_orders"."credit_release_reason")) between 1 and 300)

sales_orders_cancel_reason_check.name: sales_orders_cancel_reason_check
sales_orders_cancel_reason_check.value:
("sales_orders"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("sales_orders"."cancel_reason" is not null)
       and ("sales_orders"."cancel_reason" is null or length(btrim("sales_orders"."cancel_reason")) between 1 and 300)

targets_starts_on_check.name: targets_starts_on_check
targets_starts_on_check.value:
("targets"."period" = 'day')
        or ("targets"."period" = 'week' and extract(isodow from "targets"."starts_on") = 1)
        or ("targets"."period" = 'month' and extract(day from "targets"."starts_on") = 1)
